name: Creepy Ferris
steps: Give the baseball bat to the girl.
Give the doll to the girl.
Give the track piece to the girl.
Give the phone stand to the girl.
Give the unicycle to the girl.
Give the billboard to the girl.
Give the wine to the girl.
Give the chain to the girl.
Swipe up on the trash can to reveal an iron rod.
Give the iron rod to the girl.
Remove the headphones from her head to complete the level.
